# Business email with your name on it.

Use an address on your own domain and keep your business correspondence in accounts your business owns. We help you choose and configure the right email setup.

[Talk through your needs ↗](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/business-email#contact)

## An address that belongs to your business.

An email address on your own domain helps keep business correspondence separate from personal inboxes. Whether you are starting with one mailbox or setting up a team, we help work out which addresses, shared mailboxes and subscriptions you actually need.

We can help connect a domain you already own or arrange a new one. The important registration and administrative details should identify your business, with clear access and recovery arrangements.

Email setup is estimated around your users, domain and requirements. Domain costs, email subscriptions and setup work are identified in the estimate; email is not included in the £100 website build offer.

### Tell us where you are starting.

Let us know your domain, how many people need email and whether you have existing messages to move. If you do not have a domain yet, we can start there.

[Already have email to move? ↗](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/microsoft-365-migration)

## More than creating an inbox.

### Choose the right mailboxes

Agree individual addresses, shared business addresses and the access each person needs. We explain the Microsoft 365 or Exchange Online options relevant to your setup.

### Connect your domain

Configure the DNS records needed for the agreed email service and check the relationship between your domain, website and mail provider before making changes.

### Secure account access

Configure secure sign-ins, including multi-factor authentication where supported, and agree who holds administrative access and recovery information.

### Get ready for daily use

Help connect the agreed devices or applications, check sending and receiving, and explain how to reach us when you need technical help afterwards.

## Fresh setup or a planned move.

A new mailbox and a migration from an existing provider need different work. If you have old messages, several domains or shared accounts, we first agree what should move and what should remain accessible.

[Plan a Microsoft 365 migration ↗](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/microsoft-365-migration)

For Office apps, Teams, SharePoint and the wider working environment, explore our [Microsoft 365 services ↗](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/modern-workplace). For the website and domain alongside your email, see [digital setup ↗](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/web-presence).
